native_context: Terraform state/plan confidentiality and artifact recipients
taxonomy_note: Planning compatibility lens only. Classify the final observed root cause independently; unsupported mappings stay unassigned.

controls.boundary: Terraform state/plan confidentiality and artifact recipients — authoritative consumer
controls.source_trace: Inspect state/plan backend and artifact distribution, access policy, versioning/logging and provider/resource behavior. Identify who can obtain which saved bytes.
controls.controlled_verification: Using an owned nonsecret fixture or supplied redacted state, trace whether a sensitive value remains in saved state/plan and whether the alleged recipient can read it. Compare display redaction with actual storage; record encryption/access context separately.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: The sensitive attribute normally affects presentation and is not a universal omission guarantee. Presence in properly protected owner state is not by itself unintended disclosure.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Restrict backend/artifact access and use supported omission/ephemeral patterns where applicable to the actual provider/version. Retest normal apply/plan and the original unintended distribution path.

coverage_unit: One primary investigative assertion for this technique; not exhaustive coverage. Expand only for genuinely distinct policy/effect assertions in the actual assessment.
